source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.leaves: Pinnately compound, usually 9–15 leaflets; mature leaflets usually 15–35 mm wide (genus key)
morphology_documented.fruit: Fruit 25–35 mm diameter; nut with regular longitudinal grooves and ridges, edible kernel

source_scope_note: Genus and key details explicitly noted; where historical flora lacks a species treatment, morphology is limited to independently named secondary sources.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Historic flora documents Hood/Lampasas/Bell-or-Coryell records; not county-native Hays confirmation
Differentiated from J. microcarpa mainly by larger fruit and broader, fewer leaflets
preservation: Additive, original taxon records, photos, attribution and site unchanged
